questions.prompt:
Which color is applied to

Hello

?
questions.explanation: #intro has specificity (1,0,0), which strictly beats (0,2,1) regardless of how many classes are chained.

questions.prompt:
If .alpha and .beta both set color and .beta appears later in the CSS file, what color applies to

?
questions.explanation: Equal specificity ties are always resolved by later stylesheet source order, never HTML class order.

questions.prompt: What is the specificity of ul#menu > li.active a:hover?
questions.explanation: 1 ID (#menu), 2 class/pseudo-class (.active, :hover), and 3 element types (ul, li, a) = (1, 2, 3).

questions.prompt: What is the total rendered width (border box) of .panel?
questions.explanation: Under box-sizing: border-box, padding and border fit inside the declared 240px width (margin is external).

questions.prompt: An element has box-sizing: content-box; width: 100px; padding: 10px; border: 2px solid black. What is its total rendered width?
questions.explanation: Under content-box, rendered width = 100 + (10 * 2) + (2 * 2) = 124px.

questions.prompt:
Two sibling

elements in normal block flow have margin-bottom: 24px and margin-top: 16px respectively. What is the vertical space between them?
questions.explanation: Adjacent vertical margins collapse to max(24px, 16px) = 24px.

questions.prompt: What is the computed font-size of .inner given default root 16px?
questions.explanation: em compounds relative to its parent: .outer is 16 * 1.5 = 24px, and .inner is 24 * 1.5 = 36px.

questions.prompt: Which viewport unit dynamically adjusts height as mobile browser address bars collapse and expand?
questions.explanation: dvh (dynamic viewport height) updates continuously as browser UI chrome shifts.

questions.prompt: Why is line-height: 1.5 preferred over line-height: 150% on a parent container?
options: Unitless 1.5 inherits the scaling factor to children of any font size rather than a fixed computed pixel value
Percentage line-height is invalid in CSS3
Unitless values render faster on the GPU
questions.explanation: Percentage line-height inherits its computed pixel length from the parent, causing text overlap on larger descendants.

questions.prompt: Which box appears on top visually?
questions.explanation: .child-a is trapped inside .parent-a’s stacking context (z-index: 1), which sits below sibling .parent-b (z-index: 2).

questions.prompt: Inside a 600px wide flex container with 0 gap, what are the widths of .a and .b?
options: Depends strictly on their text length
questions.explanation: flex: 1 and flex: 2 both set flex-basis: 0%, dividing 600px in a 1:2 ratio (200px and 400px).

questions.prompt: In a container with display: flex; flex-direction: column;, which property centers children horizontally?
questions.explanation: In flex-direction: column, the cross axis is horizontal, controlled by align-items.

questions.prompt: What longhand values does flex: 1 expand to in CSS?
questions.explanation: flex: 1 sets grow: 1, shrink: 1, and basis: 0% so columns distribute space equally.

questions.prompt: How many columns does .grid create on a 1000px container?
options: Invalid mixing of px and fr
questions.explanation: After subtracting the fixed 200px column, 800px remains and is split in a 1:2 ratio (266.67px and 533.33px).

questions.prompt: Why is minmax(0, 1fr) safer than plain 1fr for columns holding code snippets or long URLs?
options: It lowers the track minimum from auto to 0 so unbreakable content cannot blow out the column width
It doubles rendering performance in Safari
It converts the grid into Flexbox on mobile
questions.explanation: Plain 1fr behaves as minmax(auto, 1fr); lowering the minimum to 0 prevents track blowout.

questions.prompt: On a 1200px wide row containing only 2 cards, how does auto-fit behave compared to auto-fill?
options: auto-fit collapses empty tracks so the 2 cards stretch to fill 1200px; auto-fill preserves empty slots
auto-fill stretches the 2 cards to 1200px; auto-fit keeps them narrow
Both produce identical layouts in all cases
auto-fit stacks cards vertically while auto-fill keeps them horizontal
questions.explanation: auto-fit collapses empty trailing tracks so populated items expand; auto-fill preserves the empty track space.

questions.prompt: When a .card-host is 320px wide inside a 1440px desktop window, which background color applies to .card?
questions.explanation: @container evaluates the container’s width (320px), NOT the 1440px viewport, so (width >= 500px) is false.

questions.prompt: Which modern media query matches viewports strictly between 640px (inclusive) and 1024px (exclusive)?
questions.explanation: Media Queries Level 4 range syntax cleanly expresses inclusive/exclusive bounds without 1px overlap.

questions.prompt: Which container-type value enables width-based @container queries while keeping automatic content height?
questions.explanation: inline-size applies inline-axis size containment without collapsing automatic block height.

questions.prompt: After a 1s fade-in animation finishes with animation-fill-mode: none (default), what opacity does the element return to?

codeSnippet.code:
.box { opacity: 0; animation: show 1s; }
@keyframes show { to { opacity: 1; } }

options: 0 (snaps back to its base CSS rule)
Browser keeps the last frame automatically
questions.explanation: With default fill-mode: none, animated values are discarded as soon as the animation completes unless fill-mode: forwards/both is specified.

questions.prompt: Which background color applies to <button class="btn primary">Save</button>?
questions.explanation: @layer overrides is declared after @layer components, so .primary beats the higher-specificity rule in components.

questions.prompt:
Given @layer base, utilities;, which declaration wins on

?
questions.explanation: Cascade layer precedence outranks specificity; @layer utilities comes after @layer base, so it wins.

questions.prompt: Which selector selects a <label> element that contains a checked checkbox?
questions.explanation: :has() matches any element whose relative selector matches at least one descendant or sibling.

questions.prompt: What color renders on .btn when --brand is NOT defined anywhere?
questions.explanation: Because --brand is unset, var() resolves to its fallback value indigo.

questions.prompt: In Tailwind CSS v4, why must you add @custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *)); when using a manual Light/Dark class toggle?
options: By default Tailwind v4 binds dark:* to prefers-color-scheme media query and ignores <html class="dark">
Tailwind v4 removed dark mode completely without plugins
It improves CSS minification size by 50%
questions.explanation: Without @custom-variant dark, Tailwind v4 dark:* classes only follow OS prefers-color-scheme.

questions.prompt: What does registering a CSS custom property with @property { syntax: "<color>"; ... } enable?
options: Smooth CSS transitions and keyframe interpolation of that variable inside gradients and color functions
questions.explanation: @property teaches the browser the data type of a CSS variable so it can interpolate intermediate frames.

questions.topic: Modern Color Spaces, Blending & Visual Effects
questions.prompt: Which background lets backdrop-filter: blur(10px) actually show a frosted glass effect?

codeSnippet.code:
.panel-a { background: #ffffff; backdrop-filter: blur(10px); }
.panel-b { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.75); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); }

questions.explanation: backdrop-filter blurs content visible behind the element; an opaque #ffffff background hides the backdrop completely.

questions.topic: Modern Color Spaces, Blending & Visual Effects
questions.prompt: Why do gradients and color scales built in OKLCH look more consistent than HSL?
options: OKLCH models uniform human perceptual lightness across all hues
HSL does not support alpha transparency
questions.explanation: OKLCH is perceptually uniform, meaning equal L values look equally bright regardless of hue.

questions.topic: Modern Color Spaces, Blending & Visual Effects
questions.prompt: Why is mask-image preferred over a background-colored overlay div for fading the edge of a scrollable list?
options: It fades the element’s own alpha channel so it works over any background or theme automatically
It forces the container to use CSS Grid
It automatically adds scrollbars in all browsers
questions.explanation: mask-image modulates element opacity directly, avoiding mismatched overlay colors in dark mode or over gradients.

questions.prompt: When a page switches to <html dir="rtl">, which edge gets the 4px indigo border?
questions.explanation: border-inline-start mirrors automatically to the right side in RTL reading direction.
